# Artifact Revision Boundaries

Adapted from `jonathan-vella/apex@c209d8bb765681aa21dce5d3cd2a3b080dad8d5e`.
Read [the authority boundary](kernel-boundary.md). Typed accepted artifacts, not Markdown/recall/sidecar files,
own current decisions and review state.

Revise the bounded document request or source task through its authorized capability, then re-render.
Do not directly edit a derived presentation to change accepted facts or artifact status.
Preserve user-authored material and unrelated sections; stop on unavailable capabilities or partial writes.

Batch independent accepted corrections where practical and validate before dependent changes.
Explain structural changes (heading reordering, template change or substantial content revision) in the typed request.
No percentage threshold authorizes a rewrite.

Finalize source content and formatting before review. Substantive changes or post-review byte changes invalidate
exact-hash evidence; refresh through the kernel, not by updating a badge or review checkbox.
Return unresolved findings to the owning task; the skill never runs an independent Challenger/recall workflow.

Token/cost savings require observed usage evidence, not line-count multipliers or model-name inference.
